text: The System Design chapter recap — 24 lessons, one connected argument, brought together.

Requirements and estimation, then storage and processing model, then Lambda and Kappa, the star schema at scale, partitioning and sharding, reliability, the three layers, caching, then multi-tenancy, freshness, and CAP.

Ride-sharing fit Kappa naturally. Fraud detection was streaming-only, leaning AP on purpose. Retail inventory actually justified Lambda. Social media's whole problem was volume. Same toolbox, four different answers, because four different requirements.

Chapter 1 is complete — twenty-five lessons, four fully worked case studies, one repeatable process. Nothing here was meant to be memorized as a fixed answer; the transferable skill is the four-step process from Lesson 24. Chapter 2, DP-700 Certification Prep, is next.
